proves.claim: clause 1: an item whose claim is refused CROSS_OWNERSHIP is passed over, reported once, and the next claimable item is offered.

moves.selection.cross-ownership-passed-o.why: A refused claim ended next with the refusal, so one item naming paths no lane owns stopped every seat in that lane (#11862).

proves.claim: clause 2: with wait above 0, an item whose claim refuses for the calling seat is never returned to it.

moves.selection.wait-never-offers-refuse.why: A waiting seat was offered an item its own claim then refused, so the wait returned at once and never blocked (#11862).
